CHARS_ROLLER.Instructions: Roll 4d6 drop lowest twice for each ability. Choose one set — this can only be done once per character!
CHARS_ROLLER.AlreadyRolled: This character has already rolled ability scores and cannot roll again.
CHARS_ROLLER.ClassSuggestion: Based on {ability} ({score}), a suggested class is: {classes}.
CHARS_ROLLER.Settings.AllowGMRerollHint: If enabled, the GM can reset and re-roll ability scores for a character even after the initial roll has been made.
CHARS_ROLLER.Settings.AbilityScorePathHi: Template for the actor data path of each ability score. Use {key} as a placeholder for the ability key (str, dex, con, wis, int, cha). Default: system.abilities.{key}.value
